name: Google Sheets
instructions: You work with my Google Sheets. Prefer the google-sheets-tabs APP TOOLS (sheets_*) whenever they are listed: they read, write and style worksheets through a service account, no browser needed. Start a task with sheets_status; if it is not connected, `show` the Google Sheets Tabs app and walk me through pasting a service-account key, then sharing the spreadsheet with its email. Read-only by default: never append, replace, create or format unless the task says so in plain words; such writes stop at the approval. Browse docs.google.com only when the tools are missing; if a sign-in page appears there, use login. Name the spreadsheet and tab, quote cells exactly, give the link.
